payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: April, Jung, Kelle, Linnea, Nickole, Tawna

payload.content: (Coordination ping) Linnea planning to take ISSUE-0001::triage (security, effort 2.8). If anyone else targets security microtasks, coordinate to avoid duplicates.

April planning: security skills high; saw Linnea intends ISSUE-0001::triage. To avoid duplicates, I’m considering ISSUE-0002 frontend microtasks (cheaper) or security review/docs/test if unclaimed. Please confirm what you’re targeting before execution.

April planning note: available 10h. Likely best cost-efficient claim is ISSUE-0002::review (frontend, cost 1.08, effort 1.0) or ISSUE-0002::test (cost 1.51). If unclaimed, I’ll take one during execution; otherwise I’ll skip.

Kelle planning (security focus). I see Linnea targeting ISSUE-0001::triage and April considering ISSUE-0002 frontend review/test. To avoid duplicates and stay cost-efficient, I will target a remaining security micro-task if unclaimed—otherwise will skip.

Kelle shortlist (security): ISSUE-0001::docs cost 4.31 effort 3.5, ISSUE-0001::review cost 4.31 effort 3.5, ISSUE-0001::test cost 6.03 effort 4.9, ISSUE-0001::implement cost 8.62 effort 7.0. If any are unclaimed after others lock, I’ll claim the cheapest feasible (docs or review).

Jung planning: with strong frontend skill and enough availability, I can take a frontend micro-task from ISSUE-0002 (review/test/implement) if not already claimed. If frontend is taken, I may take ISSUE-0001 security triage only if still unclaimed (cost 3.10) to avoid duplicates. Tell me what you’re locking in.

Nickole planning (frontend 0.81, 6h avail). To avoid duplicates with Linnea (likely ISSUE-0001::triage) and others possibly taking ISSUE-0002::review/test, I’m considering ISSUE-0002::implement (frontend) as my tentative claim if unclaimed; otherwise I’ll skip.

PLANNING STATUS (Tawna): I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::review (frontend, effort 1.0, cost 1.23). Coordinating to avoid overlap with any frontend-review takers; security tasks should not be duplicated with Linnea (likely ISSUE-0001::triage).

April planning update: I will NOT take ISSUE-0002::review if Tawna locks it. If ISSUE-0002::review remains unclaimed in execution, I can take it; otherwise my backup is ISSUE-0002::test (lower effort) only if unclaimed. I will skip security tasks (ISSUE-0001) since Linnea likely takes triage and others may take review/docs.

Kelle planning: I will avoid duplicates with Linnea’s ISSUE-0001::triage and with Tawna/April’s likely ISSUE-0002::review/test. If any SECURITY micro-task among ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::review remains unclaimed at execution time, I’ll take the cheapest feasible (likely ISSUE-0001::docs or ::review). Otherwise I’ll skip to prevent duplication.

Jung planning update: I will avoid duplicating Linnea’s likely ISSUE-0001::triage and Tawna’s likely ISSUE-0002::review. My best bet is ISSUE-0002::implement (frontend) if unclaimed; otherwise I’ll skip (or, only if all ISSUE-0002 frontend tasks are taken, consider a remaining security micro-task like ISSUE-0001::docs/review).

[Planning][Nickole] I’m favoring ISSUE-0002::implement (frontend) if it’s still unclaimed in execution. Since Tawna likely targets ISSUE-0002::review, I’ll avoid that and won’t touch security tasks (ISSUE-0001) to prevent duplication with Linnea.

(Tawna) Coalition-aligned confirmation: I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::review (frontend). Linnea intends ISSUE-0001::triage (security). Please avoid selecting ISSUE-0002::review in execution; other frontend tasks OK if available.

April planning for execution: given Tawna intends ISSUE-0002::review and Linnea likely ISSUE-0001::triage, I will avoid duplicates by either taking ISSUE-0002::test if still unclaimed, else skip. I will not take ISSUE-0001 security tasks.

Kelle planning: aligning with Linnea on ISSUE-0001::triage and Tawna on ISSUE-0002::review. I will target a remaining ISSUE-0001 security task only if unclaimed (prefer cheaper: docs or review). Otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates.

Jung planning broadcast: I will take ISSUE-0002::implement (frontend) if unclaimed. I will not take ISSUE-0002::review (likely Tawna) nor duplicate ISSUE-0001::triage (likely Linnea). Backup only if all ISSUE-0002 frontend tasks are taken: consider ISSUE-0001::review/docs (if still unclaimed).
Jung coordination request: please confirm during execution locking so we avoid duplicates on ISSUE-0002::implement / ISSUE-0002::test.

Nickole planning update: will claim ISSUE-0002::implement (frontend) in execution only if unclaimed; will not take ISSUE-0002::review (Tawna) nor any ISSUE-0001 security tasks (Linnea). If ISSUE-0002::implement already claimed (e.g., by Jung), I will skip.

Tawna coalition-aligned: will claim ISSUE-0002::review. Linnea expected to claim ISSUE-0001::triage. Please avoid duplicates on ISSUE-0002::review and avoid other ISSUE-0001 security tasks (unless triage already taken elsewhere).

April planning (phase=planning): Tawna is locking ISSUE-0002::review and Linnea is targeting ISSUE-0001::triage. To avoid duplicates, I will either claim ISSUE-0002::test (frontend) if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip. I will not claim any ISSUE-0001 security tasks.

Kelle planning broadcast: aligned with Linnea on ISSUE-0001::triage and Tawna on ISSUE-0002::review. I will claim ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::review only if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicate security claims.

Jung planning for coordination: I will claim ISSUE-0002::implement (frontend) in execution only if unclaimed. I will not take ISSUE-0002::review (Tawna) and will avoid duplicating ISSUE-0001::triage (Linnea). Backup only if all ISSUE-0002 frontend tasks are taken: consider ISSUE-0001::docs/review if unclaimed.

[Nickole planning] I will target ISSUE-0002::implement (frontend) if unclaimed; will not take ISSUE-0002::review (Tawna) or any ISSUE-0001 security (Linnea). Please confirm if anyone else plans ISSUE-0002::implement so we avoid duplicates.
